reason: The version line of `CITATION.cff` equals `prov.__version__`. `docs/releasing.md` lists the `CITATION.cff` version line among the files a release updates, and says this test fails the suite when it disagrees with `prov.__version__`.

The test reads `.zenodo.json` and asserts the licence "mit" and the ORCID 0000-0003-4937-2473 on the first creator. Section 3.5 of `planning/specs/2026-09-10-release-3.1.1-design.md` says `.zenodo.json` carries "the same creator and licence metadata" as `CITATION.cff`. The lowercase spelling follows Zenodo's licence identifier (commit 36d495c7, "use Zenodo's lowercase license identifier", which changed the file and the test together). With the licence changed back to "MIT", the whole suite failed this test and no other. The test runs no code under `src/prov`.
